summary: Trace sprite font 003 into TrueType fonts
author: pm
body:
Recreate sprite font 003 (staged/client/sprites/interface/sprite_fonts/003.png: three sizes, large, medium and small, each ASCII 32-126, frames 0-94 / 95-189 / 190-284 in its manifest) as TrueType fonts. User, 2026-11-25: "Can you send an agent to recreate the ttf's from these bitmap fonts? ... Following the edges at the center using proper font flowing techniques."

Approach:
- Trace each glyph's outline through the pixel-edge centre line (sub-pixel contour at 50% coverage), not the pixel staircase.
- Smooth it and fit quadratic curves, giving proper TrueType outlines with consistent direction, sensible point counts, and no self-intersections.
- Keep each frame's advance and its baseline from the pivot.
- Build one TTF per size with fontTools, with metrics that put the cap height and baseline where the bitmap has them.

**Done when:**
- three TTFs exist (large, medium, small);
- each renders the damage texts, "Poisoned" and coordinates close to the bitmap at its native pixel size, measured per glyph (IoU against the bitmap, with the mean reported) and shown side by side;
- the outlines pass a fontTools validation.

Shipping and wiring them into the client is a separate decision. The glyphs are Helbreath's own 1999 art, the same art we already ship as a sprite.

**Result, 2026-11-25:** traced into three TTFs (large, medium, small), 94 inked glyphs each, IoU 1.000 for every glyph against the bitmap (exact rasteriser and FreeType unhinted). Caveat: FreeType's auto-hinter (which SFML may force for unhinted fonts; unverified) shifts some glyphs by a pixel at 16 px (worst IoU 0.22-0.49); the fix is adding minimal hinting programs when the fonts are wired in. Files: .claude/scratch/editor/font_trace/ (hb_sprite3_{large,medium,small}.ttf, trace_font.py, compare.png, outlines.png, report.json). Waiting on the user: look at compare.png and decide whether to ship them.

**HD pass, 2026-11-25:** redrew sprite font 003 as clean outlines in hb_sprite3_hd_{large,medium,small}.ttf (.claude/scratch/editor/font_trace_hd/). Method: pass 1's trace, with corners only at real stem, bar and cap ends; on-curve anchors with axis tangents at every flat-run extremum; one fixed-tangent cubic per span, then quadratics. IoU is a floor (0.93, scored with a 0.06 coverage margin), not the objective. Metrics are identical to pass 1 (unitsPerEm, advances, cmap, ascender, descender, cap and x heights); only usWinAscent/usWinDescent shrink by 4-16 units because the outlines no longer overshoot. IoU at 16 px through FreeType's default path, mean/min: large 0.978/0.926, medium 0.980/0.931, small 0.991/0.938; no glyph is below 0.85. Validation: 0 problems (direction, self-intersections, lsb), no necks, identical round trip. Points 2872/3382/2690 vs pass 1's 3493/4101/3162; wobble proxy 368/480/384 vs 558/656/468. Minimal hinting: no-op fpgm, prep and glyph programs, plus gasp (grayscale, no grid-fit). Caveat: if SFML 3.0.2 forces FT_LOAD_FORCE_AUTOHINT (unverified: Font.cpp is not vendored), the bytecode does not help and medium/small minimums drop to 0.23/0.08. Overrides: large A gets a triangular counter, large a a 0.99 floor. Previews: compare_hd.png, outlines_hd.png, sample_4x.png, facets_check.png. Waiting on the user to look.

**Glyph corrections, 2026-11-25 (user review of sample_4x.png):** symbols and misreading letters are now hand-drawn (glyph_designs.py) and fitted back to the bitmap at 16 px (drawn_glyph.py). User rule: "They only need to match when scaled down - not at scale up". At 16 px each drawing is repaired by morphing it locally toward the traced outline. It is kept only if it reaches margin IoU >= 0.85, has no self-intersections and no necks, and survives the repair; otherwise the traced outline stays.
- Drawn and kept (FreeType default IoU at 16 px; unhinted is identical):
  - large 22, min 0.897 (< 0.897, # 0.935, ? 0.944, ] 0.943, a 0.962);
  - medium 23, min 0.875 ({ 0.875, # 0.903, ] 0.913, % 0.917);
  - small 24, min 0.875 (> 0.875, 4 0.938).
  - These include the asterisk in all sizes (five teardrop spokes on the bitmap's five spoke pixels), square [ ] in large and medium, large and medium a, medium 6, and small J, 4, 6, $.
  - Small \ is drawn as the Won sign the art has there (code page 949).
- Not achieved, left traced: large and medium t, 4, S, $, &; large 6, %, @; medium ~; small t, &, @, ^. Their bitmaps encode the flagged shape (large 4: two 3-px columns with a 1-px slot; large t: a solid 3x3 cap; large 6: a full 3-px stem in rows 1-3), so a re-shaped drawing cannot land on those pixels. Fixing them needs either a lower floor for those glyphs or edited bitmaps.
- Fonts:
  - Mean / min IoU at 16 px (FreeType default): large 0.976 / 0.897, medium 0.979 / 0.875, small 0.989 / 0.875.
  - Validation: 0 problems, no necks, identical round trip.
  - Metrics: unitsPerEm, advances, cmap, ascender, descender, cap height and x-height identical to pass 1; usWinAscent/usWinDescent follow the ink (3-12 units below pass 1).
  - Hinting: no-op bytecode plus gasp, as before.
- Caveat: with the bytecode stripped (FreeType's auto-hinter, which SFML may force; unverified), means fall to 0.948 / 0.893 / 0.889.
- Previews: compare_hd.png, sample_4x.png, symbols_4x.png (bitmap, before, after).

**Glyph fixes done, 2026-11-25:** the symbols and the flagged letters are redrawn and read as their characters at 4x; native match is 0.875 or better (FreeType default). Large/medium t, 4, S and large 6 are unchanged because their bitmap pixels force the shape. Shown to the user; HH-0090 wires them in. Backup: working/archive/font_trace/pass3_glyph_fixes/.

**Correction, 2026-11-25:** reopened to verified. The fonts are not committed yet (they live in scratch and the archive), so the done link to 517808c2 was wrong. HH-0086 closes with the HH-0090 commit that ships them.

**Small lowercase, 2026-11-25 (user: "The lowercase e and d need some work on the sprite 3 HD small"):** hand-drew small e, d, b, p, q, g, a, o and c (glyph_designs.py SMALL_LC). Each bowl is a 1-px elliptical ring and each stem a straight 1-px bar the bowl touches, so bowl and stem stay distinct at 4x. The e has a round bowl, a bar tilted down to the left (forced: pixel (1,5) is background and (1,6) ink) and an open lower terminal. All nine kept their drawing.
- Native IoU at 16 px (FreeType default; unhinted is identical): e 1.000, d 1.000, b 1.000, o 1.000, p 1.000, g 0.947, q 0.933, c 0.909, a 0.882.
- The other small lowercase letters read as letters already and are unchanged.
- Small font: mean 0.987, min 0.875. Validation: 0 problems, no necks. Metrics and hinting as before.
- Previews: small_lowercase_4x.png (bitmap / before / after), sample_4x.png, compare_hd.png.

**User refinement list, 2026-11-25:** large 34 35 36 43 64 94 96 123 125 126 ("All of these need to be refined, finer details brought out"); medium 36 43 91 125 126 ("125 - needs to look more like the opposite of 123"); small 36 43 125 126 ("Same issues as the others"). Rule: "Overall keys that have a mirror copy should look like a flipped version of at least one of them, so they remain similar." Earlier: "look like blobs which may differ from the original a bit and that is ok", so these glyphs may drop below the 0.85 native floor.

**Correction, 2026-11-25:** the user: "I lied the small is fine - ignore the small". This round changes only the large and medium fonts (the refinements and the mirror rule); the small font stays as it is.
